title: Chickpea and butternut stew with couscous
steps: Peel the butternut and cut it into small cubes, about 2 cm. Chop the onion. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in a pinch each of cumin, cinnamon and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the butternut, tomatoes, chickpeas and a splash of water, cover and simmer gently for about 20 minutes, until the butternut is soft when poked with a fork.
Meanwhile make the couscous: pour the same volume of boiling water over it with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff it with a fork.
Season the stew with salt and pepper and serve it on the couscous.
